_comment_kf_routing: Optional per-kf-account engine routing. Each open_kfid (微信客服 account ID)
can use a different engine + model. Without kf_routing, all incoming kf messages
use the top-level model + engine. NB: 微信客服 联合版 currently allows only 1
open_kfid per self-built app to be API-managed (manage_privilege=true), so until
you have multiple self-built apps configured, only one route here will actually
fire — others fall back to the top-level engine.
